values.Text: Hall 2 shall host the Future High-Density Cluster (4 racks at 120 kW) on row 4 after R-17.
Loop A shall have a validated cooling capacity of at least the original design load (900 kW) plus 10 % engineering margin.
The coolant temperature leaving the cold plates (Loop A return) shall not exceed 40 °C in the operating envelope (S1–S3).
The coolant supplied to the cold plates shall not exceed 32 °C (W32 class) in the operating envelope (S1–S3).
Loop A shall deliver at least 1.5 L/min of coolant per kW of heat load in the operating envelope (S1–S3).
The Loop A pressure drop at operating flow shall not exceed 150 kPa in the operating envelope (S1–S3).
After the loss of any single circulation pump, Loop A shall retain at least 50 % of the usable capacity recorded in DCIM (redundancy class N, 2 × 50 %).
Pumping electrical power shall not exceed 1 % of the heat removed at the original design load.
At the projected future AI factory load (S4), Loop A shall meet REQ-THERM-002, REQ-THERM-003, REQ-FLOW-001 and REQ-PRESS-001 with at least 10 % capacity margin.

args.name: AI Factory Cooling System
args.documentation: Complete AI Factory cooling architecture. Loop A shown as the abstract loop.

args.name: Thermal transfer
args.documentation: Q = ṁ · cp · ΔT — Q heat (kW), ṁ coolant mass flow (kg/s), cp specific heat (kJ/kg·K), ΔT return − supply (K).

args.name: Flow control
args.documentation: q = max(Q / (ρ · cp · ΔTset), Q · 1.5 / 60), capped at q_max — Controller target; when the pumps are at full speed, flow is capped and ΔT rises.

args.name: Heat exchanger (ε-NTU, counter-flow)
args.documentation: Q = ε · Cmin · (T_return − T_fw,in) ; ε = (1 − e^(−NTU(1−Cr))) / (1 − Cr·e^(−NTU(1−Cr))) ; NTU = UA / Cmin — Fixes the return temperature for a given load; supply = return − Q / (ṁ·cp).

args.name: Pressure loss
args.documentation: Δp = Δp0 + K · q² — Manifolds, heat exchangers, cold plates and valves lumped in K.

label: Constraint block Pump curve and maximum flow

args.name: Pump curve and maximum flow
args.documentation: H = H0 · s² − a · (q / n)² ; q_max where H(s = 1) = Δp(q) — n pumps in parallel share the flow.

args.name: Pump electrical power
args.documentation: P = q · Δp / η — q in m³/s, Δp in kPa, η wire-to-water efficiency.

args.name: Thermal margin
args.documentation: margin = capacity / load − 1 — Capacity = highest load that meets every envelope requirement (found by bisection).

args.name: Projected Thermal Load
args.documentation: S1 Normal load: 869.1 kW — Measured Loop A heat p95 over 24 h (869.1 kW), the same figure as the Decision Intelligence run.; S2 Original design load: 900 kW — Basis of design of Loop A (900 kW).; S3 High AI load: 989.1 kW — S1 + R-17 at its design IT load (869.1 + 120 kW), without moving any workload.; S4 Projected future AI factory load: 1469.1 kW — S3 + Future High-Density Cluster (4 × 120 kW).
